description: Final summary: appendage fold match, best-patch permutation test against AP-2 ear calibration, ligand-site conservation shift, and burial of the conserved contact residues
code:
# Final summary figure. All values are outputs of the provenance scripts in
# provenance/ap5b1/ (02_superpose.py, 03_site_tests.py, 06_conserved_patch.py,
# 07_positive_control_beta2.py, 10_patch_significance.py, 11_bestpatch_vs_site.py).
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13.5, 9.0))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.42, wspace=0.28)

# (a) fold match: TM-scores (02_superposition.json)
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
tm = [("3H1Z alpha ear + PIPKIg", 0.684), ("2IV8 beta2 ear + arrestin", 0.671),
      ("1E42 beta2 ear apo", 0.670), ("2IV9 beta2 ear + Eps15", 0.661),
      ("1KY7 alpha ear + FxDxF", 0.648), ("2VJ0 alpha ear + FxDxF", 0.611),
      ("1R4X gamma-COP ear", 0.564), ("1PZD gamma-COP ear", 0.561),
      ("1UBQ ubiquitin (negative)", 0.266)]
y = np.arange(len(tm))[::-1]
cols = ["#2f6fb5"] * 8 + ["#8c8c99"]
ax.barh(y, [t[1] for t in tm], color=cols, height=0.62)
ax.axvline(0.5, color="#c23b22", ls="--", lw=1.3)
ax.text(0.505, 8.1, "TM 0.5: same fold", color="#c23b22", fontsize=8.5)
ax.axvline(0.456, color="#555", ls=":", lw=1.2)
ax.text(0.462, -0.75, "0.456 = beta2 ear vs gamma-COP ear", color="#555", fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([t[0] for t in tm], fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("TM-score to the AP5B1 660-878 model"); ax.set_xlim(0, 0.8)
ax.set_title("(a) The fold matches. AP5B1 660-878 superposes on every\nappendage tested above the same-fold threshold.",
             fontsize=10, loc="left")

# (b) best-patch permutation test (10_patch_significance.json)
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
dat = [("AP-2 beta2 ear\n(1E42, 301 orthologs)", 0.817, 0.635, 0.715, 0.0004, 4.6),
       ("AP-2 alpha ear\n(1KY7, 438 orthologs)", 0.709, 0.558, 0.637, 0.0045, 4.4),
       ("AP5B1 appendage\n(112 orthologs)",      0.643, 0.497, 0.615, 0.0302, 22.9)]
x = np.arange(len(dat))
for i, (lab, obs, nm, p95, p, d) in enumerate(dat):
    col = "#c23b22" if i == 2 else "#2f6fb5"
    ax.vlines(i, nm, p95, color="#999", lw=6, alpha=0.5)
    ax.plot([i - 0.2, i + 0.2], [nm, nm], color="#666", lw=1.4)
    ax.scatter([i], [obs], s=110, color=col, zorder=4)
    ax.text(i, obs + 0.022, f"p={p}", ha="center", fontsize=8.5, color=col)
    ax.text(i, 0.455, f"{d:.1f} A to\nnearest ligand", ha="center", fontsize=8.5, color=col)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in dat], fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_ylim(0.43, 0.90)
ax.set_ylabel("best smoothed surface conservation patch")
ax.set_title("(b) Dot: observed best patch. Grey bar: null mean to 95th percentile\n"
             "over 20000 permutations of conservation across the same surface.",
             fontsize=10, loc="left")

# (c) ligand-site conservation: near vs far (06 + 07)
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
rows = [("AP-2 beta2 ear, IVF sandwich",      0.812, 0.388, "p<5e-5", "#2f6fb5"),
        ("AP-2 beta2 ear, Eps15 sandwich",    0.687, 0.384, "p<5e-5", "#2f6fb5"),
        ("AP-2 alpha ear, side site",         0.568, 0.334, "p=0.0001", "#2f6fb5"),
        ("AP-2 alpha ear, FxDxF platform",    0.443, 0.341, "p=0.022", "#2f6fb5"),
        ("AP-2 beta2 ear, arrestin platform", 0.453, 0.412, "p=0.264", "#8c8c99"),
        ("AP5B1, platform site",              0.219, 0.255, "p=0.694", "#c23b22"),
        ("AP5B1, sandwich site",              0.172, 0.257, "p=0.864", "#c23b22")]
y = np.arange(len(rows))[::-1]
for yy, (lab, near, far, ptxt, col) in zip(y, rows):
    ax.annotate("", xy=(near, yy), xytext=(far, yy),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=col, lw=1.5))
    ax.scatter([far], [yy], s=40, facecolor="white", edgecolor=col, zorder=3)
    ax.text(max(near, far) + 0.025, yy, ptxt, va="center", fontsize=8.5, color=col)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rows], fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(0.1, 1.0); ax.set_xlabel("mean ortholog identity of surface residues")
ax.set_title("(c) Shift from the rest of the surface (open circle) to residues\nwithin 8 A of a bound peptide (arrow head).",
             fontsize=10, loc="left")

# (d) burial of the enriched contact residues (03_site_tests.json, 04_controls.json)
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
res = [("F782", 0.002, 0.883), ("W786", 0.046, 0.920), ("G851", 0.019, 0.116),
       ("V852", 0.006, 0.165), ("L756", 0.068, 0.866), ("E795", 0.380, 0.304),
       ("W799", 0.450, 0.072), ("R843", 0.210, 0.232), ("E845", 0.370, 0.505),
       ("S796", 0.260, 0.982), ("D859", 0.260, 0.946), ("P713", 0.670, 0.875),
       ("W861", 0.640, 0.786), ("P771", 0.590, 0.613)]
mapped = set("F782 W786 G851 V852 L756 E795 W799 R843 E845".split())
for lab, s, c in res:
    col = "#c23b22" if lab in mapped else "#2f6fb5"
    ax.scatter([s], [c], s=70, color=col, zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(lab, (s, c), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(6, 4), fontsize=8.5)
ax.axvline(0.25, color="#555", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax.text(0.255, 0.04, "surface cutoff", fontsize=8.5, color="#555")
ax.set_xlabel("relative solvent accessibility in the AP5B1 model")
ax.set_ylabel("ortholog identity")
ax.set_xlim(-0.03, 0.78); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)
ax.set_title("(d) Red: AP5B1 residues mapped onto AP-2 peptide contacts. The\n"
             "conserved ones are buried. Blue: the conserved exposed patch.",
             fontsize=10, loc="left")
plt.show()
